scope: Stable native signal validation and core 0.6.1 owning Volar compatibility; parent owns final package composition

execution.dependencyInputs: Frozen latest-build-pnpm-lock.yaml; no old core/esrap patches applied

ownership.volar: packages/octane/src/compiler/volar.js; three synthetic block-comment constructors only
ownership.sourceAudit: The source archive has no production caller of validateNativeSignalNames besides its public API implementation; upstream tests and typetests are consumers.
ownership.core: Octane npm manifest declares @tsrx/core ^0.5.5 (0.6.1 is outside this range). Source compiler modules import core externally; dist/compiler/volar.js separately bundles an audited core graph. Both dependency metadata and build graph must adopt 0.6.1 in the parent.
ownership.esrap: Same source/bundle split; parent latest cohort must not merely replace metadata and retain the old Volar graph.

rootCauses.native: Stable Program exposes no public checker or getProject(). Stable Snapshot.getProject(config) provides a public Project with both program and checker. Passing the actual stable Program previously reaches program.getProject() and crashes.
rootCauses.volar: Core 0.6.1 format_comment deliberately preserves raw block-comment.value. Octane constructs *@jsxImportSource octane with no trailing whitespace; printing /* + value + */ yields /**@jsxImportSource octane*/. TypeScript consumes octane*/ as the pragma module and emits TS2875. The old core formatter had hidden Octane’s malformed synthetic-comment construction.

corrections.native: Accept public stable Project input, obtain Project.program and Project.checker, and pass the checker into the shared host. Keep nightly Program and classic Program support. A stable bare Program now fails with an actionable request for Project; no private field, wrapper monkeypatch, hidden checker, or parallel type project.
corrections.declarations: Add structural NativeTypeScriptProject union arm. Actual stable declaration test accepts Project and rejects bare stable Program with TS2345 at the program argument.
corrections.volar: Construct correctly spaced raw block-comment values before the single mapped AST print. Keep authored comments, mappings and diagnostics; no output regex, diagnostic suppression, parser fallback, or core patch.

verification.before: Fresh runner first reproduces parsed.errors.filter on exact source/stable binary, then applies only original text patch and requires native Program.getProject missing-method failure plus TS2875 on core 0.6.1 before applying either follow-up patch.
verification.nativeAssertions: Nominal real source SignalHandle identity, positive suffixed handles/tracked reads/sample values/structural lookalikes; exact full OCTANE_NATIVE_SIGNAL_NAME and OCTANE_NATIVE_MEMO_READ diagnostic objects including message/severity/file/line/column/offset/suggestions; stale source rejection in upstream suite.
verification.volarAssertions: Default synthetic, authored block override, and authored line override each retain sole TS2352 with no TS2875. Existing inference cases retain precise source mappings and error exclusions.
verification.bundleAssertions: The actual esbuild emitted-input graph contains @tsrx/core 0.6.1 and esrap 2.4.0 and contains no @tsrx/core 0.5.5. The reconstructed npm candidate runs this new bundle, not the tarball’s old bundled Volar.
verification.cleanup: Exploratory and fresh-qualification owned temporary roots removed; dependencies/build outputs registered and released.

composition.overlap: Disjoint source-file ownership among the three patches; fresh runner git apply --check verifies exact application before use.
parentRequired: Use all three source patches before the full owning build.
Migrate stable validator callers to validateNativeSignalNames(project, file, options), where project is the caller-owned snapshot.getProject(config).

Update final Octane dependency/peer metadata to the approved latest core/OXC/TS cohort; the untouched original archive and its fixture install remain identity controls, not a proposed old final dependency graph.

Rebuild dist/compiler/volar.js with core 0.6.1/esrap 2.4.0; include regenerated dependency licenses and pass the full owning declaration/license/dist verification gates. The bounded qualification reproduces the owning esbuild module boundary but does not claim the full runtime build.
Copy the authored updated typescript.d.ts and corrected plain-JS modules through the owning build.
Compose with runtime PR7/9 ports and generate the final actual npm-layout patch in the parent lane; perform downstream/framework acceptance there.
composition.supersedes: The unresolved native-validator/core-0.6.1 compatibility warnings in provenance.json are resolved by this follow-up; full build and release acceptance remain parent-owned.
